summary: LlmRequest serialization includes null fields unnecessarily, adding 4-8KB of bloat per payload in workflows with many LLM calls. The request is to strip null fields using model_dump(exclude_none=True) or equivalent, either as default behavior or opt-in via configuration flag.
userImpact: Users with workflows containing many LLM calls experience unnecessary payload bloat from null fields, increasing activity input sizes without adding information.
rootCause: model_dump() serializes all fields including those with null values, unnecessarily bloating the serialized output
proposedFix: Use model_dump(exclude_none=True) to strip null fields before passing to activity, either as default behavior or opt-in via configuration flag
workaround: Users can manually strip nulls in their subclass before passing to the activity, as demonstrated in the reporter's current implementation
keyQuote: LlmRequest.model_dump() serializes every Gemini config field even when null, adding 4–8KB of nulls per payload.
